specialities.name: Mysore Pak
specialities.why: Sri Venkateshwara Sweetmeat Stall is renowned for making the most melt-in-the-mouth, ghee-laden variant of this classic South Indian sweet.

specialities.name: Channapatna toys
specialities.why: These traditional wooden, lacquer-ware toys are a GI-tagged craft unique to the nearby Ramanagara district and widely sold across Bangalore.

specialities.name: Sandalwood oil and carved artifacts
specialities.why: Karnataka is globally famous for its fragrant Indian sandalwood, used to craft intricate figurines and pure essential oils.

specialities.name: Masala Dosa and Filter Coffee
specialities.why: Bangalore's iconic darshini culture centers around crisp, butter-laden dosas paired with strong, frothy South Indian filter coffee.

specialities.name: Ramadan street food on Mosque Road
specialities.why: During the holy month of Ramadan, Mosque Road transforms into a bustling food street famous for kebabs, haleem, and other delicacies.
